shows.description: AA members Don, Olis and Sam interview other AA members about their experience, strength, and hope in recovering from alcoholism. Expect both humor and inspiration as these AA members share their stories.

description.en: AA members Don, Olis and Sam interview other AA members about their experience, strength, and hope in recovering from alcoholism. Expect both humor and inspiration as these AA members share their stories.
description.es: Los miembros de AA Don, Olis y Sam entrevistan a otros miembros de AA sobre su experiencia, fortaleza y esperanza en recuperarse del alcoholismo. Espera tanto el humor como la inspiración ya que estos miembros de AA comparten sus historias.

items.title: Gated Communities [Season 11, Episode 12]
items.summary: Matt tells Don and Sam that he came to his first AA meeting at 17, but needed several more years of drinking before the internal bankruptcy and demoralization brought him to surrender. Matt found an AA member in prison who helped him on his journey. Matt helps others in prison as a volunteer too. His friend summed it up nicely: "I come to prison to stay out of prison." Vicky tells us about her love for Grapevine. Kenneth shares a joke. While we provide the podcast…
